description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionDao' which extends a generic DAO interface. It provides a method to list transactions associated with an Order, serving as a data access object for Transaction entities in the payment domain.

classes.name: TransactionDao
classes.description: Java interface for transaction data access, extending generic DAO functionality.
